adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `createEvent(calEventRaw, credentialId)` selects the target `calendarId` based on `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId`, but the organizer attendee email is derived from `mainHostDestinationCalendar` which is always the first element of `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar` (`const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = ...`). This means when creating an event for a non-first destination calendar (secondary host), the organizer email can incorrectly use the first destination calendar’s `externalId` instead of the one matching `credentialId`, causing the mismatch described.
